name: claude-code-toolkit
description: Claude Code guards and session hooks. Add your own checkout as a local marketplace (install.sh does this).

plugins.name: toolkit-core
plugins.description: The toolkit's guards, integrity checks and onboarding: the hooks that protect a machine, plus /onboard and /autonomy-permissions.

plugins.name: toolkit-continuity
plugins.description: Session continuity skills: /handover, /wrap-up, memory-distill and claude-md-distill.

plugins.name: toolkit-build
plugins.description: The /build workflow and its executor, task-reviewer and code-reviewer agents, plus an optional architect-reviewer.

plugins.name: skill-prompt-optimizer
plugins.description: Improve a rough or high-stakes request before doing it, and challenge the reasoning behind it.

plugins.name: skill-humanizer
plugins.description: Strip AI-writing patterns from a draft and give it a human voice, or name the patterns without rewriting.

plugins.name: skill-claude-teacher
plugins.description: Learn Claude Code and git by doing: lessons matched to your level, using your own work.

plugins.name: skill-chrome-handoff
plugins.description: Get work done in a live, logged-in web app no API can reach: drive your own Chrome, or write one paste-ready Claude in Chrome prompt, then check the report.

plugins.name: skill-port-github-repo
plugins.description: Bring a public GitHub repo into your Claude Code setup pinned to a vetted commit, and pull its upstream changes later as a reviewed change.

plugins.name: skill-model-routing
plugins.description: Pick the cheapest model and effort that still does the work well, for each subagent and for your own session, and say what that trades away.
